name: Default
shortDescription: Hotel booking website, booking engine and property management system, shipped as the official all-in-one image with Apache, PHP and a bundled MySQL server.

alerts.message: Finish the web installer on first visit. On the database step use server 127.0.0.1, database qloapps, login root and the MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD value from the environment. The account you create there becomes the back office admin.

After installing, delete the installer from the qloapps container terminal with: rm -rf /home/qloapps/www/QloApps/install-dev. Until then anyone can rerun it. The back office is served at /admin-dev/.
